g.text: Algorithm 1: PQC Sizing & Network Overhead Profiler for Banking APIs

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #e2e8f0

g.text: Mathematical & Network Performance Modeling Pipeline (REST / TLS 1.3 / ISO 20022)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff
font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • Ingest API Trace: { Endpoint, Legacy Algorithm (RSA/ECDSA), TPS, Payload Size }

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • Ingest Target NIST PQC Parameters: { Target KEM = ML-KEM-768, Target Signature = ML-DSA-65 }

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • Query PQC Benchmark Specification Matrix (liboqs / NIST FIPS 203 & 204)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Step 2: Cryptographic Key & Signature Size Lookup

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • Classical Size: S_legacy = PubKey_size(C_leg) + Sig_size(C_leg) [e.g., 256B + 256B = 512 B]

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • PQC Target Size: S_pqc = PubKey_size(ML-KEM) + Sig_size(ML-DSA) [e.g., 1184B + 3300B = 4484 B]

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • Handshake Overhead Delta: Delta_S = S_pqc - S_legacy (+775.8% payload expansion)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Step 3: Throughput & Network Bandwidth Expansion Computation

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a
font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a
font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • Bandwidth Expansion Factor: Gamma = BW_pqc / max(1.0, BW_legacy)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #ffffff

g.text: Step 4: TCP MTU Packet Fragmentation & Latency Overhead Modeling

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • Compute MTU Packet Count: Phi_pkts = ceil( S_pqc / 1500 bytes ) (1 packet -> 3 packets)

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • Model Latency Inflation: Delta_T_lat = ( S_pqc / 1500 ) * 1.5 ms [+4.48 ms overhead]

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #0f172a

g.text: • Projected Endpoint Latency: T_total = T_base + Delta_T_lat
